rationale: All four original findings are resolved in commit b6ba32eb6. CR-001/CR-002: isAuthPage now uses startsWith(base+'/auth/'), covering sub-path deployments and /auth/sign-up. CR-003: savePostLoginRedirect uses startsWith(base+'/'), preventing incorrect prefix matching. CR-004: integration test for open-redirect fallback added to SignInPage. Three additional api integration tests (sign-up guard, sub-path sign-in guard) confirm guard correctness. No new findings introduced by the fix-up diff.
